finalText:
```text
Diagnosis: Volcano job c090-vj is pending due to missing PriorityClass "missing-volcano-priority"

Evidence:
1. Job spec references non-existent PriorityClass (kubectl describe job)
2. PodGroup status shows same missing PriorityClass reference
3. kubectl get priorityclass confirms the PriorityClass is not present in the cluster

Scope:
- Affects only this job (namespace-scoped)
- Blocks scheduling until PriorityClass is restored

Confidence: High (direct configuration dependency)

Remediation:
1. Recreate the missing PriorityClass:
   kubectl create priorityclass missing-volcano-priority \
     --value=1000000 \
     --global-default=false \
     --description="Volcano evaluation priority"

2. Update the job's PriorityClass reference if needed (if the missing class was misnamed)

3. Verify scheduler re-admits the job after PriorityClass is restored
```
